claim_text: Then-Attorney General Hector Balderas asked the federal government on 15 October 2019 to begin seizing Epstein's New Mexico land holdings for the benefit of survivors.
quote: explore initiating the process to seize Epstein's New Mexico land holdings for the eventual benefit of survivors of these acts and the people of the State of New Mexico
confidence_justification: Quoted from an attached exhibit (Ex. 3 at 16). Establishes that the request was made and when; the property was instead sold at auction in 2023.
